from solution import shard_routing
assert shard_routing('4;ab,Z')=='ab=3,Z=2'
assert shard_routing('1;x')=='x=0'
assert shard_routing('0;x') is None
assert shard_routing('1025;x') is None
assert shard_routing('2;') is None
assert shard_routing('2;é') is None

import re
def shard_routing(s):
 p=s.split(';')
 if len(p)!=2 or not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*',p[0]) or not p[1]:return None
 n=int(p[0])
 if n>1024:return None
 o=[]
 for k in p[1].split(','):
  if not k or any(ord(c)<32 or ord(c)>126 or c in ',;' for c in k):return None
  o.append(f'{k}={sum(k.encode())%n}')
 return ','.join(o)
